subject: executor: handle all responses correctly (#63849)
summary:
Diff only touches `pkg/executor/simple.go` `broadcast()`: it now drains `kv.Response` by calling `Next(ctx)` until it returns `nil`, instead of consuming a single subset.

This matches the `kv.Response` contract (“nil when full result set returned”) and avoids prematurely closing the underlying cop iterator (whose `Close()` cancels in-flight RPCs), which could otherwise leave remote TiDB tasks unfinished / leaked. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`; the same draining loop remains (no subsequent fix indicating a latent high-severity issue).
